python.policy: code and dependency lock must pass both supported interpreter lines

http_host.uvicorn_install: minimal package only; do not use uvicorn[standard]
http_host.rationale: small ASGI surface, current Python support, few hard dependencies, explicit programmatic lifecycle

persistence.query_style: bound-parameter SQL through SOMA-owned repository/query adapters
persistence.connection_thread_rule: connection never crosses threads; each bounded worker obtains its own verified connection
persistence.keying_rule: LLD-01 obtains opaque 32-byte live-DEK handle from LLD-12, keys the new connection immediately, verifies SQLCipher provider/version/profile and sqlite_master readability, then applies ordinary safety pragmas; raw key bytes are never logged/audited/persisted by LLD-01
persistence.write_transaction: explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE / COMMIT / ROLLBACK under SOMA UnitOfWork
persistence.read_transaction: short read snapshot; no application-global shared connection

sqlite_runtime.foreign_keys: ON and verified per authoritative connection
sqlite_runtime.configuration_rule: failure to key/verify cipher or apply/verify required safety pragmas blocks authoritative use

migration.framework: SOMA-owned raw SQL runner; no Alembic/ORM migration layer
migration.execution: statement-by-statement inside explicit transaction; executescript is forbidden
migration.security_rule: migration connections are keyed and cipher-verified before ledger/schema reads or writes

json.canonicalization: only for contracts that require equality/fingerprint/checksum

time.rule: wall-clock local time is never persistence authority

concurrency.asgi_event_loop: transport and orchestration only; no blocking DB/file parsing
concurrency.rule: blocking application/repository work runs in bounded host-owned executors and obtains its own keyed/verified connection

security_handoff.rule: LLD-12 owns keys/authentication/security proofs and secret lifecycle; LLD-01 owns database connections, transactions, migration and runtime orchestration only.
